title: Quantitative Methods
source: Carte mentale — séries temporelles & recherche quantitative énergie
subtitle: Four crude / oil-products research projects on synthetic data: build a trustworthy dataset, clean and engineer features, respect point-in-time information, then model and defend a relationship

projects.title: Crude oil: building and understanding a market dataset
projects.question: A vendor sends three years of Brent, WTI and Dubai settlements. Can you turn the raw file into a dataset you trust, and describe what the prices and spreads say — before any model?
projects.data_focus: CSV ingestion, data dictionary, types, timestamps, duplicates and corrections, calendars, quality assertions, a small SQLite store
projects.data: p1_crude_prices_vendor_synthetic.csv — raw vendor export, deliberately imperfect

projects.title: Oil products: missing data, outliers and features
projects.question: What moves the US diesel crack, and which explanatory variables can you build from imperfect product prices without using information you would not have had?
projects.commodity: ULSD, RBOB, ICE Gasoil, jet, Brent — cracks in USD/bbl; European diesel imports
projects.data_focus: unit conversion, gaps at the start / middle / end, stale feeds, zero vs missing, z-score / modified z-score / IQR, error vs genuine shock, lags, rolling and calendar features

projects.title: Crude and products: point-in-time data and temporal alignment
projects.question: Weekly stock reports and monthly demand data are published late and revised. Can you rebuild what a desk actually knew at each date — and show how much a misaligned dataset would mislead you?
projects.commodity: US crude stocks (weekly), WTI (daily), US oil demand (monthly vintages), diesel crack (monthly)
projects.data_focus: observation / publication / availability / ingestion dates, release calendars, backward merge_asof, vintages and as-of views, pseudo vs genuine point-in-time, truncation tests

projects.title: Oil markets: econometric research and model selection
projects.question: Is WTI tied to Brent by a long-run equilibrium, which simple model describes the link best, and did the relationship survive the end of the US export ban?
projects.commodity: Brent, WTI, Dubai (USD/bbl) 2012–2019, an unrelated coffee price, US diesel demand (monthly)
projects.data_focus: clean research panel: the work is choosing transformations, specifications and tests
